scope: Candidate syntax-only intrafunction analysis; no type resolution, aliases, interprocedural flow or macro expansion
corpus: tests/fixtures/sast/rust; parse-only fixtures, not executed target applications
unsupported: Unmodeled transforms, assignment/control flow, unsupported macros and exceeded input budgets produce unknown; parse failures produce error

rules.scope: Rust straight-line let bindings; std::env::var/args to literal sh/bash -c Command builder chains
rules.evidence_policy: Candidate source and sink line numbers only; no source text or literal values

rules.scope: Rust env input in formatted SQL passed to methods named execute/query/query_row/prepare; receiver type unverified
rules.evidence_policy: Candidate source and sink line numbers only; no SQL or parameter values

rules.scope: Rust env input to axum::response::Html or warp::reply::html; ammonia::clean and html_escape::encode_safe protect HTML only
rules.evidence_policy: Candidate source and sink line numbers only; no HTML or credential values
